title: The Google claim on Create a Space says why it stopped

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: When the hand-over fails (the handle was taken meanwhile, or the draft cookie is gone), claimWithGoogle redirects to /create-a-space#get-started with no message, so the visitor presses Google again and gets the same silent bounce. The email claim shows the error. Fix: carry an error code the form turns into a line, as the email path does.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
